intent: Prove Home Sentinel physical external-effect crash/restore linearization across the exact ADGO window where a provider accepted an effect but the activity completion commit was lost, preserving durable idempotency identity and preventing blind duplicate physical application.
invariants: ADGO is treated as at-least-once; exactly-once is never inferred from task status.
The durable task and non-empty idempotency key exist before any physical provider invocation.
A provider-applied effect followed by a lost ADGO completion commit leaves recoverable durable work, not an invented successful completion.
Lease recovery/redelivery after restart uses the exact persisted idempotency key from the original task.
Confirmed duplicate delivery is safe only when the gateway/provider can identify the original idempotency key and return already-applied semantics without a second physical application.
Unknown provider outcome is never converted into a blind retry; the workflow remains in explicit ambiguous/reconciliation/human-safe state.
Crash-window tests control Store commit and lease state directly and never depend on wall-clock sleeps or scheduler luck.
Door, siren and camera recovery retain their already-verified execution-bundle identities throughout fault recovery.
A test-only critical slice must not introduce semantic-neutral production changes merely to manufacture mutation targets.
contracts: pinned Axiom ADGO Store.Create/Load/Commit and PebbleStore durability
pinned Axiom ADGO Engine task enqueue/claim/lease recovery/fencing semantics
pinned Axiom external-effect contract: persist task + idempotency before invoke, legal redelivery after lost completion commit
internal/gateway/fake DoorController, SirenController and CameraRecoveryController idempotency observability
Stage17 durable Telegram notifier crash receipt protocol is already separately verified and is out of duplicate implementation scope
internal/engloop MutationTargets excludes _test.go and I-018 applies only when a production target is selected
code_surfaces: internal/gateway/fake/* only if a genuine reusable fault-observability capability is required
acceptance_evidence: A deterministic Store decorator fails exactly the post-provider activity-completion Commit while leaving the underlying durable running task unchanged.
Before the injected commit failure, the test proves the provider applied the effect exactly once and records the task's original non-empty idempotency key.
After Pebble close/reopen, lease expiry is forced by controlled durable state mutation rather than elapsed-time waiting, and a new Engine/coordinator recovers the task.
Recovered/redelivered work presents the identical persisted idempotency key to the gateway.
Door reaches the intended final lock state while fake physical Applied remains exactly 1 across crash/recovery.

The crash-recovered siren enable is physically applied exactly once; a later safety-disable is a distinct expected physical effect that must also occur at most once, leaving the siren disabled without weakening cancellation/compensation safety.
Camera reconnect recovery reaches a verified stream state with exactly one physical reconnect application across crash/recovery.
Ambiguous provider outcomes remain explicit reconciliation/human-safe paths and do not auto-reinvoke an effect whose application cannot be proven.
Fault tests contain no time.Sleep or inflated timeout used as correctness synchronization.
Repository CI, race and security/supply-chain qualification pass.

If changed production critical Go files select mutation targets, Gremlins produces non-empty clean evidence; if changes are genuinely test-only, mutation planner selects no production target and the packet does not add artificial production code solely for mutation statistics.
